Class SpinOffHistoryBasisDecider

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.instrument.SpinOffHistoryBasisDecider
public final class SpinOffHistoryBasisDecider extends Object
Decides for one recorded spin-off whether the series a history source delivers for the parent is adjusted for it, and by which factor. The decision belongs to that series and that event, never to the identity of history and split connector: one connector delivers some events adjusted and others not, and a factor reported by the split connector was observed on another series. The rules are tried in order:
  1. a setting of the administrator for the current source that has not yet been applied;
  2. the reference: the ratio of the stored to the delivered close before and after the action date, available when the stored quotes are known to be unadjusted for the event;
  3. an applied setting of the administrator for the current source;
  4. the step of the delivered close on the action date compared with the provider split factor;
  5. otherwise undetermined.
